name: Eval Dashboard lists one run list, filtered by the selected agent
description: Opens /eval from the sidebar (AC-62's nav entry) and confirms the dashboard's own agent-summary copy renders with the seeded Security Reviewer's row stating its latest run's version, then selects that agent and confirms the run list is now scoped to it (AC-64) — the compare control only renders once an agent is selected (AC-30/SPEC-04's edge case), and the agent's own older seeded run (v1) is present in the now-filtered list. SPEC-04 collapsed the dashboard's former two lists into one (AC-62), so the old final step asserting a cost value on the premise that 'the Recent runs list carries no cost column' no longer applies — that premise died with the unified list, and the step is dropped rather than re-pointed.
